Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Black and Ivory Global Print Cotton Area Rug, 8 x 11 Foot
Colors: Black/Ivory
Materials: cotton
100% Cotton Imported Add style to your room with this global-inspired statement piece. Eclectic details, warm tones, and hand-crafted softness adds depth and big personality to small, neutral spaces. Geo print area rug in neutral tones Hand-tufted with 100% cotton Durable, lightweight flat low pile height weave fits any indoor space Pair with a rug pad (sold separately) 8' x 11' Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow a few days for natural fibers to settle
